europe_now.title: Spanish political shifts
europe_now.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced a snap election, setting off a swift campaign centered heavily on housing policy and national political stability. The upcoming vote carries significant implications for the broader European political balance and regional governance.

europe_now.title: French protests and economic strain
europe_now.summary: Student demonstrations and union-backed rallies in Paris have intensified amid reports of violent clashes and widespread public disruption. Concurrently, mounting sovereign debt concerns have placed downward pressure on the euro, stirring anxieties reminiscent of past financial crises.
